description: Check your P&L, cash position, outstanding invoices, top customers and more — directly from ChatGPT. Xero surfaces real-time financial summaries with flexible date ranges, year-over-year comparisons, and links back to Xero for deeper analysis. ChatGPT connects with read-only access. Any data retrieved is used only to respond to your questions and is never stored between sessions.
